spans.s: + उद्भेद गङ्गा- + उद्भेद, m. (the source of the Ganges) a holy place,
गङ्गदत्त, i. e. गङ्गा-दत्त (the आ of the first part is shortened; cf. the vb. दा), m. A proper name, Pañc. iv. d. 16.
गङ्गा (from *गङ्गम् for जङ्गम्, frequentat. of गम्), f. The river Ganges, supposed to exist also in the sky and in the lower regions,

गाङ्ग, i. e. गङ्गा + अ,
 I. adj., f. गी.
 1. Belonging to the Gaṅga,

.
 II. n. The name of a kind of rain-water (ascribed to the celestial Gaṅgā),

गाङ्गेय, i. e. गङ्गा + एय,
 I. adj.
 1. Belonging to the Gaṅgā,

.
 II. m. metronym. A son of the Gaṅgā,
+ द्वार गङ्गा- + द्वार, n. the locality where the Gaṅgā, leaving the mountains, enters the plains.
गङ्गा-, तीर्थ-महा-, राम- + ह्रद गङ्गा-, तीर्थ-महा-, राम- + ह्रद, m. names of holy ponds,
